similar.method: 12 nearest districts in the same district configuration, by rank-normalized distance over economically-disadvantaged % (MSI), log enrollment (SIS), English-learner % (MSI) and special-education % (MSI), equally weighted.
similar.medians_note: Peer medians are computed from ADE's published district figures; peers below 30 tested students, or whose N Tested ADE did not publish, are excluded and counted.
